# Keymaps

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-viewmodel/keymaps/sheet.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

The keys of the two keymap presets, EW and KiCad-like (Help ▸ Keyboard shortcuts shows them and lets you change them; the active preset is the Keymap setting). "Where" is the part of the window that must have the focus: `global` anywhere, `canvas`, `navigator`, `properties` or `find` only there, where such a key shadows a global one. `Ctrl` reads `Cmd` on macOS. A punctuation key (`]`, `[`) is the key at that place on a US keyboard, whatever your layout prints on it. The table is generated from the keymap sheet [`crates/ew-viewmodel/keymaps/sheet.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/crates/ew-viewmodel/keymaps/sheet.json), which the action registry generates.

| Open… | `file.open` | global | `Ctrl+O` | `Ctrl+O` |
| Save | `file.save` | global | `Ctrl+S` | `Ctrl+S` |
| Save as… | `file.save_as` | global | `Ctrl+Shift+S` | `Ctrl+Shift+S` |
| Export PDF… | `file.export_pdf` | global | `Ctrl+Shift+E` | `Ctrl+Shift+E` |
| Close project | `file.close` | global | `Ctrl+Shift+W` | `Ctrl+Shift+W` |
